entries.title: Acts 8:1
segments: ¶And Saul gave approval to his death. Now at that time a violent attack was started against the church in Jerusalem; and all but the Apostles went away into all parts of Judaea and Samaria.

entries.title: Acts 8:2
segments: And God-fearing men put Stephen's body in its last resting-place, making great weeping over him.

entries.title: Acts 8:3
segments: But Saul was burning with hate against the church, going into every house and taking men and women and putting them in prison.

entries.title: Acts 8:4
segments: ¶But those who had gone in flight went everywhere preaching the word.

entries.title: Acts 8:5
segments: And Philip went down to Samaria and was teaching them about Christ.

entries.title: Acts 8:6
segments: And all the people gave attention to the words which Philip said, when they saw the signs which he did.

entries.title: Acts 8:7
segments: For unclean spirits came out from those who had them, crying with a loud voice; and a number of those who were ill and broken in body were made well.

entries.title: Acts 8:8
segments: And there was much joy in that town.

entries.title: Acts 8:9
segments: But there was a certain man named Simon, who in the past had been a wonder-worker and a cause of surprise to the people of Samaria, saying that he himself was a great man:

entries.title: Acts 8:10
segments: To whom they all gave attention, from the smallest to the greatest, saying, This man is that power of God which is named Great.

entries.title: Acts 8:11
segments: And they gave attention to him, because for a long time his wonder-working powers had kept them under his control.

entries.title: Acts 8:12
segments: But when they had faith in the good news given by Philip about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, a number of men and women had baptism.

entries.title: Acts 8:13
segments: And Simon himself had faith and, having had baptism, he went with Philip and, seeing the signs and the great wonders which he did, he was full of surprise.

entries.title: Acts 8:14
segments: ¶Now when the Apostles at Jerusalem had news that the people of Samaria had taken the word of God into their hearts, they sent to them Peter and John;

entries.title: Acts 8:15
segments: Who, when they came there, made prayer for them, that the Holy Spirit might be given to them:

entries.title: Acts 8:16
segments: For up to that time he had not come on any of them; only baptism had been given to them in the name of the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: Acts 8:17
segments: Then they put their hands on them, and the Holy Spirit came on them.

entries.title: Acts 8:18
segments: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the touch of the Apostles' hands, he made them an offering of money, saying,

entries.title: Acts 8:19
segments: Give me this power, so that when I put my hands on anyone he may get the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Acts 8:20
segments: But Peter said, May your money come to destruction with you, because you had the idea that what is freely given by God may be got for a price.

entries.title: Acts 8:21
segments: You have no part in this business, because your heart is not right before God.

entries.title: Acts 8:22
segments: Let your heart be changed, and make prayer to God that you may have forgiveness for your evil thoughts.

entries.title: Acts 8:23
segments: For I see that you are prisoned in bitter envy and the chains of sin.

entries.title: Acts 8:24
segments: And Simon, answering, said, Make prayer for me to the Lord, so that these things which you have said may not come on me.

entries.title: Acts 8:25
segments: So they, having given their witness and made clear the word of the Lord, went back to Jerusalem, giving the good news on their way in a number of the small towns of Samaria.

entries.title: Acts 8:26
segments: ¶But an angel of the Lord said to Philip, Get up, and go to the south, to the road which goes from Jerusalem to Gaza, through the waste land.

entries.title: Acts 8:27
segments: And he went and there was a man of Ethiopia, a servant of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, and controller of all her property, who had come up to Jerusalem for worship;

entries.title: Acts 8:28
segments: He was going back, seated in his carriage, and was reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.

entries.title: Acts 8:29
segments: And the Spirit said to Philip, Go near, and get on his carriage.

entries.title: Acts 8:30
segments: And Philip, running up to him, saw that he was reading Isaiah the prophet, and said to him, Is the sense of what you are reading clear to you?

entries.title: Acts 8:31
segments: And he said, How is that possible when I have no guide? And he made Philip get up by his side.

entries.title: Acts 8:32
segments: Now the place in the book where he was reading was this: He was taken, like a sheep, to be put to death; and as a lamb is quiet when its wool is being cut, so he made no sound:

entries.title: Acts 8:33
segments: Being of low degree, his cause was not given a hearing: who has knowledge of his family? for his life is cut off from the earth.

entries.title: Acts 8:34
segments: And the Ethiopian said to Philip, About whom are these words said by the prophet? about himself, or some other?

entries.title: Acts 8:35
segments: So Philip, starting from this writing, gave him the good news about Jesus.

entries.title: Acts 8:36
segments: And while they were going on their way, they came to some water, and the Ethiopian said, See, here is water; why may I not have baptism?

entries.title: Acts 8:38
segments: And he gave orders for the carriage to be stopped, and the two of them went down into the water, and Philip gave him baptism.

entries.title: Acts 8:39
segments: And when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord took Philip away; and the Ethiopian saw him no more, for he went on his way full of joy.

entries.title: Acts 8:40
segments: But Philip came to Azotus, and went through all the towns, preaching the good news, till he came to Caesarea.
